notes: Task-independent synthetic absolute-world TCP references. Task IDs only select fixed physical scenes; no task/object/success/contact inputs enter reference generation or conversion.
All methods use identical response-compensated translation with inverse_weight=0.5 and normalized command rate=5/s. Only rotation conversion differs.
Gripper input stays exactly zero, preserving the restored gripper.current_action and its normalized motor targets; actual motor controls are checked every step.
No gain change, initial-state repair, oracle/expert reference, model inference, privileged contact, or task success scoring. The current controller.goal_ori is an allowed observed control state.
Large rotation steps are deliberately infeasible in one control interval; report whole-trajectory tracking and each constant-reference hold separately.
Run all twelve bowl trials before the twelve wine trials; each trial owns a fresh CPU OSMesa subprocess. Existing result directories are not overwritten.
